newsitem.title: USA: Atlas Air see "flattish" Q1 - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Air see "flattish" Q1 - analysts.

text.p: Atlas Air Inc on Tuesday told analysts in a conference call that it expected its first-quarter results to show little change from the same period last year, analysts said.

"There were some comments in the conference call that created some uncertainty about the first quarter. They said the first quarter would probably be flattish compared to last year," said Michael Shonstrom of Neidiger Tucker Bruner.
Atlas Air, which provides cargo services for major international airlines, also told analysts that certain maintenance expenses were running higher than expected.
